_comment: Maintainer-decision dispositions for issue #741 (vendor-radar needs-human, 2026-11-18). Five of the six rows re-surface candidates already decided in the 2026-11-16 issue #731 review, which closed unshipped before its dispositions landed; this review re-fetched every repository keylessly from the GitHub API on 2026-11-18 and records the decisions against the 2026-11-18 evidence. No roster, verdict, or score changes.

dispositions.name: gputaskman
dispositions.reason: Maintainer decision: rechecked live 2026-11-18. The repository describes "A GPU task manager for Windows, Linux, and WSL: per-process VRAM, GPU activity, and LLM model/KV-cache insights". The gpus arena ranks current GPUs and AI accelerators, hardware products; a software monitoring tool that observes GPU activity is not a GPU. The same candidate was skipped for local-llm-runtimes in the issue #731 review (reports/vendor-radar/2026-11-16-issue-731-review.json) on the same observes-versus-runs distinction. The young-repo velocity flag is consistent with a widely followed author (175 forks) and is moot given the arena-fit failure.
evidence: https://api.github.com/repos/shanselman/gputaskman — fetched 2026-11-18; description "A GPU task manager for Windows, Linux, and WSL: per-process VRAM, GPU activity, and LLM model/KV-cache insights for NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel GPUs (plus Huawei Ascend on Linux)"; stars=3533 created=2026-11-03 forks=175 language=Python.
open-rankings/categories.json gpus definition: Current GPUs and AI accelerators for gaming, workstation, and datacenter workloads.
reports/vendor-radar/2026-11-16-issue-731-review.json — prior skip for local-llm-runtimes on the same product.

dispositions.name: Wireless-Device-Battery-Monitor
dispositions.reason: Maintainer decision: rechecked live 2026-11-18. The repository describes a Windows tray app that shows the battery level of wireless mice, headsets, keyboards, and controllers on the taskbar. It performs no screen perception, input injection, or multi-step task execution, so the device-agents definition is not met; the lexical match (device, devices, keyboard, windows, app) is noise. The velocity flag (~2104 stars/day on the issue #741 triage; 3955 stars on a repo created 2026-11-16 at recheck) is moot given the arena-fit failure and is noted for any future renomination.
evidence: https://api.github.com/repos/krisgfx9/Wireless-Device-Battery-Monitor — fetched 2026-11-18; description "Show the battery level of wireless mice, headsets, keyboards and controllers on the Windows 10/11 taskbar. Lightweight tray app, no vendor software needed."; stars=3955 created=2026-11-16 forks=349 language=C++.
issue #741 — star velocity ~2104/day exceeds the 500/day anomaly floor (2026-11-18 triage).
open-rankings/categories.json device-agents definition: Agents that operate real phones and computers through hardware or OS-level control.

dispositions.name: db-branch
dispositions.reason: Maintainer decision: the issue #731 skip (reports/vendor-radar/2026-11-16-issue-731-review.json) stands. Rechecked live 2026-11-18: the description is unchanged, "Instant MySQL database branches on ZFS clones, clustered across VMs with ProxySQL routing". A database branching tool is not an AI code review agent; the lexical match (branch, ci, agent) is noise against the ai-code-review definition. The tripped stars-per-contributor floor (67 stars / 1 contributor on the issue #741 triage; 69 stars at recheck) is moot for this arena and noted for any future renomination.

dispositions.name: Agweb
dispositions.reason: Maintainer decision: the issue #731 skip (reports/vendor-radar/2026-11-16-issue-731-review.json) stands. Rechecked live 2026-11-18: Agweb remains "A browser built for agents", a local macOS WebKit desktop browser that coding agents drive from the shell. It is not an isolated cloud execution environment where agents run untrusted code, so the agent-sandboxes definition is not met. The tripped stars-per-contributor floor (270 stars / 3 contributors on the issue #741 triage; 272 stars at recheck) is noted for any future renomination in another arena.
evidence: https://api.github.com/repos/paul-nameless/agweb — fetched 2026-11-18; description "A browser built for agents - no focus stealing, a tiny footprint, all tabs in one view."; stars=272 created=2026-11-11 forks=8 language=Swift.
open-rankings/categories.json agent-sandboxes definition: Isolated cloud execution environments where AI agents safely run untrusted code.

dispositions.name: HGhub
dispositions.reason: Maintainer decision: the 2026-11-09 parking (reports/vendor-radar/2026-11-09-issue-669-review.json), reaffirmed in the issue #731 review, stands. Rechecked live 2026-11-18: stars=10072 with forks=8550 on a repo created 2026-11-03, and the issue #741 triage measured ~674 stars/day, still above the 500/day anomaly floor; popularity remains unverifiable keylessly. The repository still describes itself as "Plug-in media player", which does not meet the device-agents definition, so verified popularity alone would not qualify it. Not ranked. Reconsideration requires a maintainer recheck of the popularity evidence and a new dated disposition before any approved bring-up.
